rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion narrow and administrable: §1108(b)(2)(A) is an exemption/affirmative defense not a pleading element, while emphasizing dismissal remains proper when the exemption is apparent on the face of the complaint and Twombly/Iqbal still applies to §1106’s elements. Barrett and Kavanaugh are the leading alternative authors given their central role in the McKelvey/Dixon framing and their focus on preserving Rule 12 screening without rewriting ERISA.
